title: vilan.toml
description: A Vilan package, library, or project (workspace) manifest.

package.description: A package: a buildable, importable unit.

name.description: How other packages import this one. A valid identifier (letters, digits, underscore; no leading digit).

description.description: A short, free-text description of the package.

root.description: The package source root, relative to this manifest. `entry` and every `pkg::` module resolve against it. Default: `src`.

entry.description: The `build`/`run` entry file, resolved against `root`. Default: `main.vl`. Replaced by `[entry.<name>]` sections.

target.description: The default build platform. `none` is a pure library (core std only) — type-checkable but not buildable without a host.

library.description: A library: an importable unit with a `lib.vl` surface, no entry, and per-platform layers instead of one target.

name.description: How dependents import this library. A valid identifier (letters, digits, underscore; no leading digit).

description.description: A short, free-text description of the library.

root.description: The base (shared) source root, relative to this manifest. Default: `src`.

layer.description: Overlay layers, keyed by layer name (`process`, `browser`, …). A module in a layer shadows the base for the platforms that layer serves.

root.description: The layer's source root, relative to this manifest. Default: `src/<layer name>`.

platform.description: The platforms this layer serves — at least one. A runtime, a runtime version, or a family like `@process`.

project.description: A workspace root: member packages, plus dependencies they can inherit.

packages.description: Paths to the member package directories — the build set of `vilan build .` at the root.

entry.description: Build entries of a multi-entry package, keyed by name; each name labels its `dist/<name>.js` output.

path.description: The entry file, resolved against the package `root`. Default: `<name>.vl`.

target.description: The entry's build platform. Must be a host — an entry is something to run.

build.description: Code-generation options. A `preset` initializes every knob; individual keys then override it.

preset.description: A named starting point. `debug` is readable (indented, source names); `release` is minified and obfuscated.

indent.description: Lay the output across lines with indentation (vs one flat line).

spaces.description: Pad tokens with spaces (`a + b`, `[ 1, 2 ]`) vs tight (`a+b`, `[1,2]`).

readable-names.description: Name generated identifiers after their source (most debuggable).

debug-names.description: When `readable-names` is off, annotate obfuscated names with their source (`a/*count*/`).

depth.description: Nested expansion rounds before the fixpoint gives up (default 16).

dependencies.description: Package dependencies, keyed by the name they are imported under. A table gives a local `path`, a `git` repository pinned to a `tag` or `rev`, or `project = true` to take the workspace root's declaration.

oneOf.description: A registry dependency version requirement (e.g. "1.2"). Registry dependencies are not resolved yet.

path.description: A local directory, relative to this manifest.

git.description: The repository URL of a git dependency. The checkout must be a `[library]` with its `vilan.toml` at the root.

tag.description: The tag a git dependency pins (exactly one of `tag` / `rev`). A branch cannot be pinned — it moves.

rev.description: The commit SHA a git dependency pins (exactly one of `tag` / `rev`).

branch.description: Rejected: a branch moves, so it pins nothing. Use `tag` or `rev`.

project.description: `project = true` takes this dependency's whole declaration from the workspace root's `[project.dependencies]` (paths there are relative to the project root). Combines with no other key.

version.description: A registry dependency's version requirement. Registry dependencies are not resolved yet.

registry.description: The registry to fetch from. Not resolved yet.
